outcome: Mode of delivery (forceps, vacuum, cesarean section)
cohort: 3,771 women who underwent operative vaginal delivery (forceps or vacuum) or cesarean section
finding: Patient-level factors such as induction of labor, nulliparity, and maternal age influenced the choice of operative vaginal delivery instrument (forceps vs. vacuum) and the likelihood of cesarean section.
mod_finding: Odds of forceps delivery were higher with induction, nulliparity, epidural, maternal indication for operative delivery, older maternal age, and longer second stage, while odds of cesarean were higher with maternal indication, presence of a perinatologist, longer second stage and labor, and older gestational age.
